ns2:course.label: Modern Britain
ns2:course.description: History of modern Britain's social, economic, cultural and political life with a special emphasis on the role of empire in shaping its career as a global power and its "domestic" national culture at home. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One year of college history.
